chunks: And he was asked about a man who has contact with a woman in what is short of the private part: is ghusl required upon her if he ejaculates and she does not ejaculate?
He said: “There is no ghusl upon her, and if he does not ejaculate, then there is no ghusl upon him.”

key_terms.غُسْلٌ: ritual bath required for major ritual impurity

ai.seo_question: Is ghusl required after intimate contact without intercourse if only one partner ejaculates?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ghusl in a case of sexual contact without intercourse. It states that the woman is not required to perform ghusl if she does not emit, and the man is likewise not required to perform ghusl if he does not emit.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications:
Hadith.186 – (Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as)) was asked about a man who engages in contact with a woman without intercourse, and he ejaculates but She does not.
Is ghusl (ritual bathing) required for her?
Imam (as) said: 'She is not required to perform ghusl. If he does not ejaculate, then he is also not required to perform ghusl.'
